scope: Offline comparison of the exact unsigned M8.2 RPM fixtures; this is not an installed PIN-unlock acceptance result.

source_inspection.rejected_downgrade: The preinstall script invokes candidate_check before package-suspend. candidate_check rejects a lower EVR before state loading, locking, service stop, gate changes, policy loading or file replacement.
source_inspection.successful_upgrade: Suspension closes the gate and stops services. The same packaged SELinux policy is loaded; the transaction trigger checks preserved account/credential/throttle binding and restores prior services and active gate.
source_inspection.status_limit: Available status checks account eligibility, storage and cooldown, but does not perform TPM unseal or prove remaining shared TPM dictionary-attack budget.

limits: Package headers, build metadata and installation timestamps are outside the payload-equality claim.
No guest, authentication, TPM, service, policy-load or package-install operations were performed for this comparison.
Post-upgrade PIN success, active reboot continuity and final erase/restored-password acceptance remain separate runtime cases.
